adaptation_rule: Per the owner amendment 2026-09-11 and docs/QUBIT_DASHBOARD_REBUILD_PLAN.md, the pinned Hermes React/Vite/Node frontend is vendored into frontend/hermes-web (from hermes-agent/web) and frontend/hermes-shared (from hermes-agent/apps/shared) and is built with Vite; React/TS is a supported Qubit dashboard runtime and the former static-only runtime constraint no longer applies. Every upstream file maps to a byte-identical vendored file or a documented Qubit patch/rebrand carrying upstream+Qubit hashes, a reason, and an affected regression test in docs/HERMES_SOURCE_COMPARISON.json; routes/endpoints additionally map to shared Qubit backend operations, tested policy refusals, or documented omissions.

/chat.note: Qubit-safe native chat: POST /api/qubit/chat (voicebridge.agent.turn, the same module as CLI text and voice PTT) with typed loading/empty/error/retry states, browser speech input, per-session transcript persistence, and the sessions switcher. /api/pty is refused (PTY_NO_SHELL); the page no longer opens or retries it.

/sessions.note: sessions op (receipt sessions) + actions receipts; Hermes rename/export/import/prune/search/stats map to memory + task stores per PARITY_HERMES sessions row.

/files.note: files_inspect/list/read (project-root confined); Hermes mkdir/upload-stream refused (write policy, no bypass).

/analytics.note: insights/activity/reports/logs journal-derived views; token-billing charts omitted (local runner has no token economy; owner: local-runner).

/cron.note: schedules_* ops + opencode/task_run; blueprints map to task-templates + schedules_create.

/mcp.note: mcp inventory; server mount/execution refused (direct-MCP bypass policy).

/env.note: key-reference status only; value reveal refused (secret policy).

/system.note: runtime/doctor/product/package/verify/backup/sync/etc.; gateway process control refused (single event path).

/api/console.disposition: OMITTED:PTY (browser PTY spawn refused; transcript+TUI equivalent)

/api/plugins/kanban/events.disposition: partial: plugin WS upgrade refused by the single event path; board reads stay live via /api/plugins/kanban/board and all mutations run through /api/ops/* + /api/ops/confirm

/api/pty.disposition: REFUSED:PTY_NO_SHELL (Qubit-safe equivalent = native chat turn; frontend no longer connects the raw WS)
